tools.name: refunder_resolve_cashback_deeplink
tools.description: Given a merchant URL or domain, return a Refunder cashback deeplink if Refunder partners with that store. The shopper must open the deeplink while logged in to Refunder to earn.

url.description: Merchant URL or domain, e.g. https://www.zalando.se

tools.name: refunder_search_stores
tools.description: Search Refunder partner stores and their cashback rates. Each result includes a deeplink the shopper opens (while logged in to Refunder) to shop with cashback.
